records.head: contradicts_ruling_or_lore
records.where: design/concepts/Contagion/cleanse/bars.json bar tissue (meant.source, range.varies 'natural arm/natural leg'); rule R_batch; rule R_identity; definition.md Runner-up paragraph; ambiguities.md item 18
records.evidence: The owner's ruling (record.json s_next_version_2026_11_16, OWNER:1794842455892769878) says: "Everything about the Grown Limbs is next version." record.json d_limbs_next_version adds that 0.1.0 ships grownLimbsEnabled off. The record's inventory also says "The custom limb recipes are Design Version 0.2.0 with the Grown Limbs". The natural arm and leg the proposal keeps are literally the Grown Limbs: RM_GrownArm and RM_GrownLeg are defined in src/RimMandrake/Contagion/Defs/ThingDefs/RM_GrownLimbs.xml and installed by RM_InstallGrownLimbs.xml through Recipe_InstallGrownBodyPart. The proposal keeps them as a delegated reading, with Questions: 0. Its deletion argument ('deleting restoration makes these ordinary outputs decorative') fails if arms and legs leave the batch pool. The ordinary organs (kidney, liver, lung, heart) alone already meet d_other_tissue's 'other matched or sellable tissue'.
records.would_pass: The 0.1.0 ordinary batch is natural organs only. RM_GrownArm/RM_GrownLeg and their install recipes move to next version, off, with the other Grown Limbs. Alternatively, the reading is put to him as a question with this evidence, and the obvious default (defer) is taken meanwhile.
records.smallest_fix: Take natural arm/leg out of tissue.range, R_batch, R_identity and C_batch's pool. Move them to next_version.md under the Grown Limbs. Change tissue's accept picture ('the desired leg is absent') to name an organ. Keep matched-mood feedback on the patched vanilla organ recipes.

records.head: authority_unsourced
records.where: design/concepts/Contagion/cleanse/owner_pages.md page one ('Dive and Bodyprints also stay under your explicit retention'); definition.md 'Kept exceptions'; next_version.md 'expressly owner-retained'; census.json row bodyprints why
records.evidence: His only words are OWNER:1792162786418789127 (2026-10-16): "keep both in (Dive and Bodyprints stay in THIS sprint)". That was said a month before Design Versions existed. The mapping of 'this sprint' to 0.1.0 is record.json d_dive_bodyprints_stay, kind 'delegated', speaker 'agent', an evidence-for-ask inference. The proposal presents it as his express 0.1.0 retention. That label is what protects the four-phase Bodyprint sequence (carcass, skin, print, eater arrival, timed fade) from the cut his 2026-11-16 words aim at ('Little custom details that weren't strictly necessary'). The fallback deletion argument over-reaches. The standing no-vanishing ruling asks only for 'a readable sign', not phased prints and eater travel.
records.would_pass: The pages say plainly that he kept Dive and Bodyprints 'this sprint' on 2026-10-16 and that reading this as 0.1.0 is the Designer's delegated call. Bodyprints' phases and eater arrival either carry a deletion argument against land, life or signature that does not rest on his authority, or go to next version with only a readable death sign kept.
records.smallest_fix: Re-attribute the claim on owner_pages.md, definition.md, next_version.md and census.json bodyprints as delegated from d_dive_bodyprints_stay. List it on page two as a settlement he should check.

records.head: cannot_hold_together
records.where: design/concepts/Contagion/cleanse/bars.json bar refuge.says ('or in water'); rule R_shade ('Consume one shared geometric shade/exposure service … including ruled water'); rule R_engines ('Do not redesign CreatureBehaviors'); meeting shelter-geometry
records.evidence: The shared service has no water term [measured]. In src/RimMandrake/CreatureBehaviors/Source/RM_MapComponent_ShadeGrid.cs, ShadeAt combines roof, cast, light, gear, parasol and moving shade, and ExposureAt adds parasol, moving shade and glare. Neither reads terrain water. Only the local predicate RM_ContagionSkyExtension.cs:95 (RM_SkyKernel.Exposed(…, t.IsWater, …)) does, and R_shade bans it. ambiguities.md item 4 forbids a second local water predicate. d_burn_refuge_is_geometry rests on the false premise that the shade grid 'calls … water' shade. As written, the refuge bar's water case can pass only by redesigning a shared engine, which R_engines forbids, or by keeping the banned local predicate. The shelter-geometry meeting's 'why' does not name this gap.
records.would_pass: Either the shared engine's owner is asked, as a named dependency need, for a water-cell cover term in the exposure contract (ticketed with its acceptance test, and the meeting says so), or water leaves refuge.says until that contract exists.
records.smallest_fix: Add the measured gap to the shelter-geometry meeting. Add one dependency ticket to CreatureBehaviors' owner: 'water cell counts as UV cover in ShadeAt/ExposureAt', with an acceptance test that fails on today's grid. Or delete 'or in water' from refuge.says and the matching accept picture.

records.head: core_promise_weakened
records.where: design/concepts/Contagion/cleanse/bars.json bar arrest (range.varies, sees.start 'Progressing eligible patient with already applied mutation') and bar body_change
records.evidence: The owner certified record.json d_efa_q05 (2026-11-15): "the first warning and the treatment it calls for are judged together." The proposal splits these into body_change (warning before change) and arrest (start state already mutated). Neither range nor picture covers holding the beam on a worker who shows only the early warning and has no mutation yet. T-deck adds a new pre-onset state. A plausible build makes that state a separate hediff the Sunbeam's IsTouched check (RM_SunbeamArrest.cs:31) does not see. Both bars would then pass while the warning calls for a treatment that cannot act until after the first lasting change.
records.would_pass: arrest.range includes a touched worker before onset with no mutation. An accept picture shows a warned, still-unchanged worker held under the beam who never gains a first mutation, and a reject picture shows the beam refused or useless at the warning stage.
records.smallest_fix: Add 'pre-onset warned, zero mutations' to arrest.range.varies and arrest.sees.start, and add the one accept/reject pair.

records.head: evidence_cannot_tell
records.where: design/concepts/Contagion/cleanse/bars.json bar refuge (live_only: false; live_only_why 'Production-derived deterministic harness can decide this bounded claim'); result.json counts.live_only_bars 8; owner_pages.md 'live-only bars: 8'
records.evidence: Refuge's own reject pictures are 'The shadow drawn on screen and the cells that protect a pawn disagree' and 'the path chooser offers a sealed roof room that the pawn cannot enter'. The first needs the renderer. The second is path/job execution, which every other bar in the file says 'Requires the running renderer, actual path/job execution'. An offline harness compares predicate to grid; it cannot see a drawn shadow that disagrees with protection. Its sees.control already relies on live off-trunk, trunk and open probes. The live-only count printed for him is therefore understated.
records.would_pass: Refuge is marked live-only for the drawn-shadow and reachable-route parts, with the offline sweep as a prefilter. The counts in result.json and on page one agree.
records.smallest_fix: Set refuge live_only true with a live_only_why naming the renderer and path execution. Change counts.live_only_bars to 9 and the page-one line to match.

R1.evidence: bars.json tissue.range.varies now reads 'Actual pool kidney/liver/lung/heart'. Its left_out excludes 'any Grown Limbs output, including natural arms/legs'. The accept picture now says 'the desired kidney is absent'. meant.source cites 'OWNER:1794842455892769878 and record.d_limbs_next_version defer all Grown Limbs, including RM_GrownArm/RM_GrownLeg and their install recipes'. R_batch says 'kidney/liver/lung/heart only; all Grown Limbs, including natural arms/legs, are deferred'. R_identity says 'Patched vanilla organ surgery and matched mood stay; all Grown Limbs recipes, abilities and removal defer'. C_batch names a pool of 'kidney/liver/lung/heart only' and the T25 removal. census.json adds row grown_natural_limbs with fate next_version and ticket T25. next_version.md has section 'grown_natural_limbs' (line 63/65). tickets.md T25 switches grownLimbsEnabled off by default and keeps OrganInstallGenomeMatch on the shared worker. definition.md Runner-up says 'The ordinary pool is kidney, liver, lung and heart only. All Grown Limbs ... defer'. ambiguities.md item 18 now takes reading B.

R2.evidence: owner_pages.md page one: 'You kept Dive and Bodyprints “this sprint” on 2026-10-16; reading that as 0.1.0 was delegated, not your express version retention.' Page two lists the settlement: '“This sprint”: the 0.1.0 Dive/Bodyprints mapping was the Designer's delegated call.' next_version.md 'Kept exceptions' says the mapping 'is delegated, speaker agent, not express owner version retention'. census.json bodyprints is now fate next_version with ticket T-spec-bodyprints. Its why says the mapping 'is delegated, speaker agent'. Dive is kept on a signature argument: census preburn_dive why says 'removing it defeats the actionable native forecast and pre-injury refuge response'. The remains bar now asks only for 'a recognizable corpse, bodily remnant or husk'. Phases, eater and timed fade move to left_out as next version, off.

R3.evidence: The would_pass first branch is met. The shelter-geometry meeting's why now says 'Measured source gap: RM_MapComponent_ShadeGrid.cs ShadeAt/ExposureAt have no terrain-water term ... T-water-cover asks the CreatureBehaviors owner for water-cell UV cover ... no local water fallback'. tickets.md T-water-cover is addressed to 'Dependency owner: CreatureBehaviors' and asks that the 'water cell counts as UV cover in ShadeAt/ExposureAt'. Its acceptance test compares dry and water cells and states 'Today's ShadeAt lacks that water/dry distinction, so the witness fails before delivery'. R_shade now treats water as 'a required dependency, not present grid behaviour'. ambiguities.md item 4 records that the delegated premise is false.

R4.evidence: arrest.range.varies begins 'Touched patient pre-onset warned, zero mutations'. sees.start reads 'Eligible pre-onset warned patient with zero mutations ... Establish the warned state by natural exposure'. There is a new accept picture: 'A worker showing only the early touched warning and no mutation can receive the held beam; completion arrests that warned state ... never gains a first mutation'. There is a new reject picture: 'The Sunbeam refuses a warned, still-unchanged worker, or a completed hold is useless until after the first mutation'. sees.control adds an untreated sheltered control so that merely having no mutation cannot pass. T-deck says 'Expose the pre-onset warned state to Sunbeam eligibility even if it uses a separate hediff'.

R5.evidence: The refuge bar now has "live_only": true. Its live_only_why reads 'Requires the running renderer to compare drawn shadows with protected cells, and actual path/job execution ... M3 is an offline prefilter'. In bars.json, 9 of 11 bars carry live_only true. result.json counts.live_only_bars is 9, and owner_pages.md page one says 'live-only bars: 9'. models.md M3 says 'This model is an offline prefilter; refuge remains live-only'.
